component.name: deconz
component.description: TAPPaaS module deconz: triage of its own critical/high CVEs (#788). The deconz VM (iotCloud zone) runs two things: deCONZ natively from nixpkgs (services.deconz, Qt5 C++, -platform minimal, DynamicUser, REST/Phoscon on 8080 and websocket on 8443 for Home Assistant cross-zone from srvHome and for the Phoscon UI via the firewall's Caddy proxy, mgmt only), and diyHue in a podman container from docker.io/diyhue/core pinned by digest, with --network=host serving the Hue API on 80/443 (Python/Flask, OpenSSL), SSDP on UDP 1900 and Hue Entertainment DTLS (openssl s_server) on UDP 2100 to the SysAP inside the iotCloud zone. The task brief described the container as deCONZ; the repo shows the container is diyHue (a Python Hue-bridge emulator on debian:stable-slim) and deCONZ is not containerised, so all image findings are about diyHue. diyHue's only configured backend is deCONZ on localhost; Tradfri (coap-client-gnutls), Bluetooth lights (bleak/bluez) and proxies are not configured, and the VM has no Bluetooth adapter. The module is not deployed on the test site, so nothing was inspected live: image claims rest on src/home/deconz (deconz.nix, deconz.json, README/DESIGN) and on diyHue's published .build/Dockerfile and BridgeEmulator source at master (commit 3ee04617, 2026-10-05), which is newer than the pinned digest (validated 2026-06-17); its CMD is `python3 -u HueEmulator3.py --docker` with no other daemons. The NixOS-side packages come from an approximated closure (not built): the nixpkgs deCONZ package links only qt5 qtserialport/qtwebsockets and openssl, so gstreamer/cups/libtiff/libxslt/libssh are at most transitive libraries that no headless service exercises.

Risk here: low. Action: Bump the pinned diyhue/core digest to a build on a fixed Debian package, re-verifying the bind-mounted deconz.py/Group.py patches. GnuTLS TLS-client hostname-verification bypass (CN fallback); nothing in the diyHue image makes TLS connections through gnutls (curl and Python use OpenSSL; the gnutls CoAP client is for unconfigured Tradfri support).
